decision.reason: [ev-01f887c4c0c4] is only a PR title, "return to DoNotSchedule". It doesn't name the field, setting, chart value or component that changed. The same section includes [ev-548fd57f2706], "Use ScheduleAnyway instead of DoNotSchedule", so #6584 looks like it reverts that earlier change within this release, and the net change may be none. However, neither item says what the setting is, what the before/after values were from the user's point of view, or who is exposed. To write the assertion we would need the PR #6584 diff or description, or an upgrade-guide section naming the affected setting.
